_comment: MIDDLE-EXIT = ATR STOP calibration. Forces UseATRStop=1, swapping the RSIOS failed-bounce middle exit for a hard ATR stop at PurchasePrice - StopATRMult×EntryATR. NOTE: SFIN's calibrated default is UseATRStop=0 because a 2026-06-16 loss analysis found the ATR stop net-negative (knocked out by noise on trades that later recovered). Run this only to re-test that conclusion if the screen surprises you. go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker SFIN -strategy reversion -interval Day1 -calibrate data/params/sfin/reversion_cal_atrstop.json -out ./reports/SFIN_atrstop -months 50 -test-months 12 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 20
